source.pattern: most recent production release is Version (\d+\.\d+)

scope: Fresh integrated source-bound native qualification: ExifTool 13.55 production release, native qualification of synthetic fixtures against the frozen runtime: retained on jpeg: inventoryPhotos, inspectMetadata, auditMetadata, compareMetadata, editMetadata, removeMetadata (JPEG photo inventory, inspect, audit and compare, metadata edit and removal); E3 on jpeg: correctTime, geotagFromTrack, locate, reconcileTime, setLocation; E4 on jpeg: applySidecar, copyMetadata, exportSidecar, organiseCopies, planNames; E5 supported operation and container pairs (scopes tiff, dng, png, webp, heif): applySidecar (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); auditMetadata (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); compareMetadata (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); copyMetadata (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); correctTime (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); editMetadata (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); exportSidecar (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); geotagFromTrack (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); inspectMetadata (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); locate (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); organiseCopies (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); planNames (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); reconcileTime (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp); removeMetadata (dng, png, tiff, webp); setLocation (dng, heif, png, tiff, webp). No pixel decoding, codec, conversion, authenticity, provenance, privacy, capture-truth or MWG claim. TIFF and DNG minimise, HEIF removal and minimise, creating HEIF Exif or XMP items, thumbnails outside JPEG, BigTIFF, maker raw, JPEG XL and GIF are not supported. Only synthetic hand-built fixtures were exercised, not every individual field in every container. Launcher-bound input lifecycle holds do not establish a stop inside ExifTool parsing.
acceptance: Run tools/qualify_exiftool.py with ExifTool 13.55 and a Calc runtime; require independent literal expectations, refusals before native, refreshed-digest semantic mutants, integrity probes, live timeout/cancel and a typed Calc handoff.
Re-check https://exiftool.org/history.html for the production release before any absorption; never absorb a development release by recency.
